texts.en:
Remarkable! We have discovered spacefaring alien entities that may or may not be intelligent, but, let's face it, probably are. Their true nature will remain a mystery to us until we complete the appropriate project to Investigate them. I suggest we do so post-haste, lest they investigate us first...

To investigate a First Contact;

£dot_green£ Open the Situation Log
£dot_green£ Click on Show First Contact

                            £firstcontact£

First Contact can also be initiated by clicking the icon on the Galaxy map
